Ammo.name: ClipAmmo
Ammo.description: The number of bullets in a clip

Ammo.name: AmmoPerShot
Ammo.description: Amount of ammo consumed by each shot

Ammo.name: LowAmmoCutoff
Ammo.description: Ammo count (either in the clip, or overall) at which 'low ammo' warnings will appear on the weapon

Damage.name: Damage
Damage.description: Damage the weapon does, before considering multipliers, falloff etc.

Damage.name: DirectHitMultiplier
Damage.description: Damage multiplier to apply to the damage done on a direct hit

Damage.name: EnergyDrain
Damage.description: Amount of energy to drain from targets

Damage.name: DamageAgainstArmorMultiplier
Damage.description: Multiplier for damage against armoured targets

Damage.name: DamageAgainstBaseTurretMultiplier
Damage.description: Multiplier for damage against base turrets

Damage.name: DamageAgainstGravCycleMultiplier
Damage.description: Multiplier for damage against Grav Cycles

Reloading & Firing.name: HoldToFire
Reloading & Firing.description: Whether the player can hold the button to keep firing

Reloading & Firing.name: CanZoom
Reloading & Firing.description: (Currently not working) Whether the weapon may be fired while zoomed

Reloading & Firing.name: ReloadSingle
Reloading & Firing.description: Whether the weapon should be reloaded one bullet at a time, like the Light's shotgun

Reloading & Firing.name: ReloadApplicationProportion
Reloading & Firing.description: Proportion of the way through the reload that ammo actually reloads; affects reload cancelling

Reloading & Firing.name: BurstShotCount
Reloading & Firing.description: Number of shots in a LAR burst

Reloading & Firing.name: BurstShotRefireTime
Reloading & Firing.description: Time between shots in a LAR burst

Reloading & Firing.name: SpinupTime
Reloading & Firing.description: Time for chain-gun type weapons to spin up before firing begins

Impulse.name: ImpactMomentum
Impulse.description: Amount of momentum applied to a player hit by this weapon

Impulse.name: SelfImpactMomentumMultiplier
Impulse.description: Multiplier to apply to the impact momentum when the player hit is the one who shot the weapon

Impulse.name: SelfImpactExtraZMomentum
Impulse.description: Additional vertical momentum to apply when self-impulsing

Falloff.name: ExplosiveRadius
Falloff.description: Size of the weapon's damaging explosion

Falloff.name: BulletDamageRange
Falloff.description: Size of the damage range (not the total range of the weapon)

Falloff.name: MaxDamageRangeProportion
Falloff.description: Proportion of the damage range at which falloff starts

Falloff.name: MinDamageRangeProportion
Falloff.description: Proportion of the damage range at which falloff ends

Falloff.name: MinDamageProportion
Falloff.description: Proportion of the normal damage dealt at the MinDamageRangeProportion

Miscellaneous​.name: DoesImpulseFlag
Miscellaneous​.description: Whether the weapon's explosion pushes the flag around

Miscellaneous​.name: DoesGibOnKill
Miscellaneous​.description: Whether this weapon will cause a killed enemy to explode into pieces

Miscellaneous​.name: GibImpulseRadius
Miscellaneous​.description: Radius for which gibbing impulse is applied to pieces of deceased enemy

Miscellaneous​.name: GibStrength
Miscellaneous​.description: Momentum applied to gibbed pieces of an enemy

Projectile & Tracer.name: ProjectileMaxSpeed
Projectile & Tracer.description: Cap on the absolute projectile speed, regardless of inheritance

Projectile & Tracer.name: CollisionSize
Projectile & Tracer.description: Radius of the projectile's collision sphere

Projectile & Tracer.name: ProjectileInheritance
Projectile & Tracer.description: Proportion of the shooter's velocity the projectile inherits

Projectile & Tracer.name: ProjectileLifespan
Projectile & Tracer.description: How long the projectile travels for before exploding in midair

Projectile & Tracer.name: ProjectileGravity
Projectile & Tracer.description: Multiplier by which gravity affects the projectile

Projectile & Tracer.name: ProjectileBounceDamping
Projectile & Tracer.description: For projectiles which don't explode on impact, the proportion of energy lost on bounce

Projectile & Tracer.name: HitscanRange
Projectile & Tracer.description: The range of the hitscan weapon

Projectile & Tracer.name: FireOffsetX
Projectile & Tracer.description: Offset to the player of the spawned projectile in the X direction (forwards/backwards)

Projectile & Tracer.name: FireOffsetY
Projectile & Tracer.description: Offset to the player of the spawned projectile in the Y direction (left/right)

Projectile & Tracer.name: FireOffsetZ
Projectile & Tracer.description: Offset to the player of the spawned projectile in the Z direction (up/down)

Fractal Grenades.name: FractalAscentTime
Fractal Grenades.description: How long the Fractal takes to float off the ground to full height

Fractal Grenades.name: FractalAscentHeight
Fractal Grenades.description: Height off the ground that the Fractal ascends to

Fractal Grenades.name: FractalShardDistance
Fractal Grenades.description: Horizontal distance which Fractal shards extend to

Fractal Grenades.name: FractalShardHeight
Fractal Grenades.description: Vertical distance above/below the Fractal which shards extend to

Fractal Grenades.name: FractalShardDamageRadius
Fractal Grenades.description: Damage radius from the end of each shard

Melee.name: MeleeDamageRadius
Melee.description: Distance at which melee will hit

Melee.name: MeleeConeAngle
Melee.description: Angle of the cone for which melee will hit

Accuracy.name: Accuracy
Accuracy.description: Proportion of accuracy for the weapon's shot

Accuracy.name: AccuracyLossMax
Accuracy.description: Maximum decrease in accuracy at a given time

Accuracy.name: AccuracyCorrectionRate
Accuracy.description: Rate at which accuracy returns after decreasing

Accuracy.name: ShotgunUseGOTYSpread
Accuracy.description: Whether to use the older GOTY-patch shotgun spread (tighter, random) as opposed to the OOTB-patch spread (wider, non-random)

Grenades & Thrown Weapons.name: ThrowDelay
Grenades & Thrown Weapons.description: Time taken for the projectile to be thrown

Grenades & Thrown Weapons.name: ThrowPullPinTime
Grenades & Thrown Weapons.description: Time before the pin is pulled; after this it will be spawned even if the thrower dies

Grenades & Thrown Weapons.name: StuckDamageMultiplier
Grenades & Thrown Weapons.description: Multiplier for damage when projectile is stuck to an enemy

Grenades & Thrown Weapons.name: StuckMomentumMultiplier
Grenades & Thrown Weapons.description: Multiplier for impulse when projectile is stuck to an enemy

Grenades & Thrown Weapons.name: ExplodeOnContact
Grenades & Thrown Weapons.description: Whether the projectile explodes on contact with an enemy

Grenades & Thrown Weapons.name: ExplodeOnFuse
Grenades & Thrown Weapons.description: Whether the projectile explodes after its fuse timer

Grenades & Thrown Weapons.name: MustBounceBeforeExplode
Grenades & Thrown Weapons.description: Whether the projectile must bounce at least once before exploding due to a fuse

Packs.name: PackSustainedEnergyCost
Packs.description: Energy per second to maintain a given pack

Packs.name: ThrustPackImpulse
Packs.description: Forward momentum given by a thrust

Packs.name: ThrustPackSidewaysImpulse
Packs.description: Sideways momentum given by a thrust

Packs.name: ThrustPackMinVerticalImpulse
Packs.description: Minimum amount of vertical impulse given by a thrust

Packs.name: ThrustPackCooldownTime
Packs.description: Cooldown before thrust can be used again

Packs.name: ThrustPackSpeedRangeStart
Packs.description: Speed at which impulse generated by a thrust begins to falloff

Packs.name: ThrustPackSpeedRangeEnd
Packs.description: Speed cap at which thrust impulse is fully lowered

Packs.name: ThrustPackSpeedCapReduction
Packs.description: Proportion of thrust impulse reduced when past the speed cap

Packs.name: ShieldPackEnergyCostPerDamagePoint
Packs.description: How much energy is consumed by the shield pack when taking a point of damage

Packs.name: JammerPackRange
Packs.description: Radius for how far the jammer pack effect extends

Packs.name: PackBuffAmount
Packs.description: Buff effect amount for buffing packs like the energy recharge pack

Packs.name: StealthPackMaxSpeed
Packs.description: Speed threshold past which a stealthed player is visible

Deployables.name: DeployableRange
Deployables.description: Range of a deployable (e.g. turret range)

Deployables.name: DeployableMaxAllowed
Deployables.description: Maximum number of deployables of this type a player can have

Deployables.name: DeployableMinProximity
Deployables.description: How close two deployables of the same type can be placed

Deployables.name: TurretTimeToAcquireTarget
Deployables.description: How long a turret takes to lock onto a target

Deployables.name: TurretCanTargetVehicle
Deployables.description: Whether the turret can target vehicles

Deployables.name: ForcefieldMinDamage
Deployables.description: Minimum damage incurred by passing through a forcefield

Deployables.name: ForcefieldMaxDamage
Deployables.description: Maximum damage incurred by passing through a forcefield

Deployables.name: ForcefieldMinDamageSpeed
Deployables.description: The minimum speed at which damage will be dealt when passing through a forcefield

Deployables.name: ForcefieldMaxDamageSpeed
Deployables.description: The speed at which the maximum forcefield damage occurs

Mines.name: MineDeployTime
Mines.description: How long before the mine is active and armed

Mines.name: MineMaxAllowed
Mines.description: Maximum number of mines of this type a player can have out

Mines.name: MineCollisionCylinderRadius
Mines.description: Radius of the collision cylinder used to check detonation

Mines.name: MineCollisionCylinderHeight
Mines.description: Height of the collision cylinder used to check detonation

Mines.name: ClaymoreDetonationAngle
Mines.description: Cone angle at which the Claymore will trigger

Mines.name: PrismMineTripDistance
Mines.description: Amount the Prism Mine's tripwire extends left and right
